comments.author: yifanxuaaa
comments.body:
Owner direction recorded on 2026-09-30 for #286 Family 4: **the remaining large-edit / multi-file reconciliation limit is an architecture scalability flaw, and the broader architecture fix is deferred from this run. Skip further 10,240-write attempts and exclude that selection from the current run’s required qualification; finish the remaining scoped Family 4 benchmark/checkpoint.** Keep the registered selection visible as **SKIPPED / OWNER-DEFERRED**, and preserve every existing receipt and diagnostic unchanged.

This updates the deferred scaling work in §3 of this umbrella issue. The already-collected 10,240 result remains a truthful **known canonical Commit followed by local `KnownCommitLocalFailure / Capacity`, with no installed local revision**. Its exact bytes, retained ownership and refusal to replay were checked. That custody proof is not successful complete Workspace Commit or clean-close capacity at 10,240 writes, and is not a product scalability qualification.

The current implementation’s disk-backed active state is followed by Commit paths that materialize dirty-inode vectors, per-file extent vectors, accumulated deletion-key lists, a whole reconciliation patch and ordered/index scratch in memory. The admitted-memory peak therefore grows with dirty-file count and surviving extent/namespace fragmentation. A single-file 10,240-write failure is a meaningful warning for real workloads with thousands of files and repeated scattered mutations; no claim that those workloads have already been measured or qualified follows. Repeated overwrites of the same region can replace prior fragments, so raw syscall count alone is not the scaling variable.

The existing two-production-LOC fix [94af0d79b](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/commit/94af0d79b) moves deletion keys into the already-admitted patch and releases the redundant source list before ordered/index scratch. This restored **8,192-write successful Workspace Commit** under the unchanged 8 MiB Budget: complete functional command 12,900,220,000 ns; Commit 1,554,850,709 ns; full old/new/held-pin bytes and checked zero-allocation/reservation close PASS. It changes no codec, storage format, quota, worker or deadline. [Source-bound r060 report and compact receipts](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/2b1302454ed78f19ba82814d8005276f2f33f2d4/core/docs/issues/286/experiments/20260930-workspace-commit-native-counts-r060.md).

The fix addresses a later peak. At 10,240 writes, the earlier whole-patch admission still overlaps the prepared key list. Source-derived reservations for the registered separated-write schedule are:

| Reservation | 8,192 writes | 10,240 writes |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Prepared deletion-key list | 3,145,728 B | 3,932,160 B |
| Whole update patch | 3,646,138 B | 4,557,498 B |
| Subtotal before existing Workspace state | 6,791,866 B | 8,489,658 B |
| Fixed total memory Budget | 8,388,608 B | 8,388,608 B |

These are admitted Budget charges, not process RSS measurements. The 10,240 subtotal already exceeds the entire Budget before ordinary Workspace state. Patch admission is at [active_reconcile.rs:132](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/94af0d79b/core/crates/layerfs-workspace/src/commit/active_reconcile.rs#L132); the source list is released later at [lines 208–211](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/94af0d79b/core/crates/layerfs-workspace/src/commit/active_reconcile.rs#L208). Whole dirty-inode collection is visible in [scan_dirty](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/94af0d79b/core/crates/layerfs-workspace/src/commit/active.rs#L253). Existing diagnostics confirm known canonical outcome, absent installed revision and capacity refusal; post-unwind Budget values must not be presented as peaks.

**Separate follow-up scope:** specify bounded-memory dirty-file/extent traversal and reconciliation, with incremental ownership transfer or a persistent streamed patch/candidate. Preserve atomic final-root publication, selected G1 bytes and continuing live G2, held pins, known/unknown outcomes, physical completion funds and checked refunds. Qualification must cover dirty-file count × surviving fragments per file, realistic creates/renames/deletes/package changes, repeated Commit and selected-view custody under fixed limits. Merely increasing Budget, batching visible per-file publication, or moving the failure boundary is not that architectural proof.

**Current-run disposition:** no further architecture refactor or 10,240 attempts for this concern; retain the historical outcome, explicitly defer the limitation here, and finish the other Family 4 checks/report. Reuse unaffected earlier-family evidence, especially the Family 2 storage group. This owner ruling does not waive the existing numeric cache contract, establish constant RAM or arbitrary multi-file scalability, authorize a PR merge/release, or close this deferred issue.

comments.author: yifanxuaaa
comments.body:
### #286 Family5 follow-up: repeated validation of a 270-level directory chain

Owner direction: record this performance finding here, defer its optimization, and continue #286 Family6. This is a source/receipt diagnosis of the existing r066 sample; **no new performance run, product patch, codec change or qualified speed comparison** was made.

`workspace-namespace-components-270-sdk-v1` creates270 nested `d` directories through ordinary public SDK Exec/POSIX-FUSE, enters each by directory descriptor, writes/reads the4-byte `leaf` file, then commits. It tests component access beyond the canonical256-component full-path limit. Full old/new listings, modes, bytes, pre-existing inode identities, known head/parent and checked cleanup PASS. [Workload at measured source d4a4252ca](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/d4a4252caa54a0dbb7454971d4ae8f169bd11c6d/core/benchmark/fs-bench-pro/families/workspace_namespace.py#L75); [r066 report and compact source-bound receipts](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/b5dcefa8ec47882d500bcdedd2a82ace52774291/core/docs/issues/286/experiments/20260930-workspace-namespace-sdk-r066.md).

| Retained interval | ns |
| --- | ---: |
| Complete SDK launch-to-exit |2,805,615,834 |
| SDK Exec |1,157,090,208 |
| SDK Commit |767,457,958 |
| Remaining lifecycle/operation exterior |881,061,959 |
| Checked cleanup (inside exterior) |491,220,500 |
| Separate independent full verifier |201,375,042 |
| Host canonical namespace `validate` phase (inside Commit) |483,269,583 |

The validation phase consumes about63% of Commit. The effective-cycle checker loops over every rebound directory binding and starts a fresh descendant walk and `seen` set for each: [cycles.rs outer loop](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/d4a4252caa54a0dbb7454971d4ae8f169bd11c6d/core/crates/layerfs-content/src/filesystem/validate/cycles.rs#L44), [fresh walk](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/d4a4252caa54a0dbb7454971d4ae8f169bd11c6d/core/crates/layerfs-content/src/filesystem/validate/cycles.rs#L70). In this chain, the walks repeatedly traverse overlapping suffixes. **Source-derived quadratic work pattern in depth**:270+269+…+1=36,585 directory visits for that shape. This is an algorithm/workload calculation, not an instrumented counter or a universal measured growth law. The483ms timer covers all validation; the precise cycle-check share is not separately timed.

Exec also performs271 separate inode-reservation calls (270 directories +1 file): the creation path requests `ReserveInodes {count:1}` [per creation](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/d4a4252caa54a0dbb7454971d4ae8f169bd11c6d/core/crates/layerfs-workspace/src/filesystem/active_create.rs#L119). The retained trace contains272 HistoryCommand events; one final canonical command is523,983,042ns host/525,619,334ns daemon, and the other271 sum63,395,370ns host/176,369,280ns daemon. The daemon figure includes host round-trip overhead and lies inside Exec; these overlapping intervals must not be added together. Projection records542 lookups and1,628 getattrs. Remaining Exec cost is not fully separated into270 shell utility launches, FUSE and local Workspace work; no invented exclusive attribution.

Deferred optimization targets: share/reuse the final-batch cycle/reachability proof to avoid repeated suffix walks while preserving cycles, unique parents, replacement/removal and mixed existing/new-tree rejection; separately investigate bounded inode-reservation amortization with identity, charged ownership and known/unknown outcome guarantees. Do not remove validation, enlarge work/memory/worker/deadline limits, add command-specific APIs or substitute a warm speed arm. Existing #270 acceptance and this issue's bounds/custody requirements still apply.

Family5 remains15/15 registered functional selections covered; all numeric cache verdicts INELIGIBLE. This is a useful performance limitation despite an under-bound functional result. Production LOC stayed135638 (reference65417/Core70221, Family5 delta0). The10240 reconciliation architecture deferral remains independent and unchanged. Next is #286 Family6 mixed ordinary Workspace mutations, retained/live views and checked failure custody, using the fast path and reusing earlier proofs.

### Related #286 Family6 limitation: unmount/delete are not dirty-discard or graceful-close proof

Family6 found an unsupported benchmark assumption, not a reason to remove the product's dirty-state guard. Original `workspace-mutations-shell-exit7-no-commit-sdk-v1` r069 creates a private directory/file, returns exact known exit7 and makes no Commit. SDK unmount and Sandbox delete report success, but captured daemon shutdown logs `sandbox shutdown retained: Busy`; the evaluator preserves **cleanup FAIL**. Complete5,816,837,209ns; cleanup5,481,638,875ns. [Immutable source-bound r069 report/receipts](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/6cc872ea7/core/docs/issues/286/experiments/20260930-workspace-mutations-sdk-r069.md).

Core [close_clean_until](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/2f49da750/core/crates/layerfs-workspace/src/runtime/lifecycle.rs#L73) intentionally refuses dirty files with Busy. Unmount detaches FUSE; no public SDK dirty-discard operation was supplied. Sandbox deletion confirms Docker container/volume removal and may force-stop after its grace period; its success cannot stand in for a graceful Workspace clean-close/custody proof. Keep this distinction explicit for callers and future discard/delete policy or acknowledgement design. No new discard API, guard removal, quota/time extension or product patch is introduced in this campaign.

A distinct prospectively frozen v2 workflow now demonstrates existing supported recovery: observe unchanged canonical head after known exit7, Pin and fully read7B accepted private state, unmount/observe open retained owner, then explicitly Commit as the benchmark owner's declared recovery, check known parent/new tree, held bytes/lease release and clean shutdown. r070 PASS complete5,244,737,792ns /15s, explicit Commit16,663,500ns, full separate proof31,544,833ns /<9s. [Recovery spec](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/6cc872ea7/core/docs/issues/286/FAMILY6-RECOVERY-SPEC-20260930.md), [proof/report](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/6cc872ea7/core/docs/issues/286/experiments/20260930-workspace-mutations-sdk-recovery-r070.md). This is explicit later recovery, never automatic Commit or rollback of failed commands. Original v1 remains failed/unrelabelled and was not repeated.

Family6's current3 native +4 SDK functional scopes are covered; known/unknown native custody intentionally retained/archived, relevant earlier proofs reused. All numeric cache results remain INELIGIBLE. Production LOC unchanged135638 (reference65417/Core70221), Family6 delta0. The270-level validation/reservation optimization already reported here and10240 reconciliation architecture deferral remain unchanged. Family7/#256 scope is next; no release/merge or arbitrary scalability claim.

comments.author: yifanxuaaa
comments.body:
The owner now prioritizes deferred correctness and memory risks before further scaling/concurrency features or broad tuning. The existing Core and Deferred tasks have received this priority update; in-flight frozen checkpoints and their receipts are preserved.

**Revised order:** (1) current-source memory/correctness risk inventory; (2) bounded file replay plus whole dirty/frontier/namespace/reconciliation processing and G1/G2 incremental-base/failure-custody proof; (3) narrow lifecycle/capacity/framing/measurement repair with recorded file ownership; (4) broader optimization and #249/#219 concurrency after prerequisite gates.

Confirmed at main7edddbdb8: active Commit collects dirty rows, file extents/descriptors, directory rows/prepared bytes; local reconciliation collects PreparedRows, deletion keys and update-patch state. These arrays are charged, but resident demand still scales with final fragments/files/names. Default8MiB Workspace accounting Budget is not a whole-process/cgroup RSS guarantee. The Core83de99c2d candidate removes per-file extent/descriptor collection only; whole-frontier/reconciliation memory and overlapping G2 Base substitution remain explicit follow-ups. Candidate final proof is in progress, not merge/admission evidence.

Other scalability risks to triage: 128 simultaneous Workspace handles and32 held view leases; old snapshots retain actual backing until checked release; dirty failed commands cannot use unmount as discard; current FUSEstatfs returns zero capacity; callback interruption/daemon-death cleanup; selected16KiB pinned-read success versus the historical32KiBIo observation and declared128KiB API bound; #283 ineffective memory.peak reset and full cache/phase-memory attribution; #235 telemetry loss and #174 historical residual audit. Their scopes include features, deliberate safety retention, recorded failures and measurement limitations—do not call all of them current product bugs.

The historical10240 native case had known canonical/local-completion Capacity before the later page-credit change. It remains OWNER-DEFERRED/SKIPPED, so its current post-fix verdict is unknown and10240 is not a declared universal edit cap. Additional physical completion credits do not establish bounded RAM.

The deferred C1fc258d184 candidate reuses completed descendant proofs; retain its exact-root/final-parent/alias/refusal tests and explicitly account for completed-map, pending DFS and effective-entry state under the existing ordering allowance before further tuning. Count improvements are not a whole-process memory or latency claim.

Use source/retained evidence first, prospective small count/resource probes where necessary, no unchanged-arm resampling or routineFamily2/whole-seven sweep. Preserve quotas, workers, limits, storage tolerance and known/unknown guards. Each risk report must distinguish confirmed-current, fixed/reused, historical changed-source, unverified and host-capability-limited items, with the exact limitation and smallest next proof/fix.
